sloka: तद् बभूव शितैः बाणैः खर राम विसर्जितैः ।परि आकाशम् अनाकाशम् सर्वतः शर संकुलम् ॥३-२८-८॥
transliteration: tad babhūva śitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ khara rāma visarjitaiḥ ।pari ākāśam anākāśam sarvataḥ śara saṁkulam ॥3-28-8॥

translations.english: The arrows released by Khara and Rama on one another filled the entire sky. Everywhere only arrows and no sky could be seen.
